youtube_description:
Jason Bourne and Aaron Cross gets hunted by the Asset (Played by Daniel Craig), after getting framed for the MI6 Headquarters attack.

Hey guys, for those that didn't catch the reminder in the title, in the beginning (green screen) and the end credits, this video is 100% FAKE, fan-made, concept trailer.

►Is there are real movie coming soon?

As of the making of this video, no official movie coming soon. This dream trailer was created in hopes to inspire fans, screenwriters, actors and directors so that one day it will come true!

►What Makes MacamTV Unique?:

I make fan made trailers as realistic as possible. This means avoiding actual clips from the franchise unless for flashback or transforming it using special effects. Otherwise the clips I use any clips that could create a realistic storyline.

►Why become a member of MacamTV?

As a solo creator, managing the channel takes a lot of work, such as researching, planning, making thumbnails, creating trailers and staying on schedule to release trailers every week. Your support will help me a lot!

Editing Details:

Jason Bourne 6 has become a dream trailer series in my channel. This is actually the 8th trailer I made because of how well receive the dream trailers are. I think people really wants to see Matt Damon back. And I think the big reason that made people specially interested is the plot of having the Asset to be played by James Bond himself Daniel Craig. Right away I made the trailer kick off the plot of Jason Bourne and Aaron Cross wanted in the Philippines. By hiring a news person I was able to make this realistic, even showing a scene of Jason Bourne watching the news in his laptop.

Part of the fun is the police chase scene. And recently figured out that it would be realistic if the police chase was from a Philippine show which I implemented in the previews trailers already. This time I made Daniel Craig chase our hero in motorcycle with the police. It was perfect music choice using the Doctor Strange TV Spot trailer music because it brings that epic action feel to the trailer. “You had every chance to get out of here” line from Wind River was perfect for Aaron Cross to say to Jason Bourne, talking about the choice to get out of Manila. As a James Bond fan its a treat to bring him in the Jason Bourne world. The trailer turn out to be good and looking forward to continuing this series.
